name: CarbonCompass
tagline: Recommends city neighbourhoods for a new business, scored for sustainability on a 3D map.
problem: New businesses choose locations without weighing environmental impact.
solution: Describe the business; AI suggests two or three areas on a 3D map colour-coded by a green score covering energy, waste, transit and zoning, with an explanation.
demo_moment: Team-described: type 'eco café' and see the scored neighbourhoods.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Coolant Climate Tech Challenge” among 160 submissions.
Balances profit and environmental fit in one recommendation.

lessons: Bring sustainability into a decision people are already making.
